case_data.name: Wall-side bay - parking at aisle end

design.setting: Perpendicular end bay: goal parallel to the side wall, rear body 0.5055 m from the back wall.

provenance.reference: New physically aligned end-bay design; local wall-bounded bays in Vlasak et al. [106], Fig. 8
provenance.adaptation: The target follows the side wall and the parking row. A back wall locates the rear of the bay; the opposing car defines the aisle. No free-standing corner pillars.

search.reference: Dolgov et al.2010, Dolgov et al. (2010), Sec.2
